description: 391 classic 16x16 ASP.NET Icons as GIFs, PNGs, and a CSS sprite sheet for classic ASP.NET applications.
391 classic 16x16 ASP.NET Icons as GIFs, PNGs, and a CSS sprite sheet for ASP.NET Core applications.
A broadsheet-newspaper Tesserae custom theme: off-white newsprint, serif text, hairline column rules, small-caps labels and one spot red.
An engineering-blueprint Tesserae custom theme: Prussian-blue drafting paper with a faint grid, white linework, dimension-line borders and stencil capitals.

A character-terminal Tesserae custom theme: green phosphor on black glass with scanlines in dark mode, a green-bar line-printer printout in light mode; monospace type, box-drawing frames and an inverse-video block cursor.
A frosted-glass Tesserae custom theme: translucent blurred panels over a soft colour field, specular edges and generous radii.
A high-contrast, accessibility-first Tesserae custom theme: AAA contrast, thick focus rings, underlined links, no meaning by colour alone, forced-colors aware.
A 1980s Memphis-style Tesserae custom theme: squiggles and confetti patterns, clashing pastels, thick black outlines and offset solid shadows.
A Japanese paper-and-ink Tesserae custom theme: rice-paper texture, sumi-ink black, a vermilion seal-stamp accent and generous whitespace.
An e-paper Tesserae custom theme: pure greys, no motion at all, dithered shadows and crisp 1px rules, built for a slow refresh.
A desktop-glass Tesserae custom theme after the translucent macOS look: vibrancy sidebars and toolbars over a wallpaper, window chrome, system-blue accent and native-feeling controls.

The JetPack theme of JetPack.Wpf for ASP.NET Core: CSS for every control, a dependency-free script for drop-downs, calendars, menus, tabs, flyouts and dialogs, tag helpers named after the WPF controls, and Material Design Icons.

Idiomatic, SWIG-like double-precision C# binding for the Bullet Physics Library (bullet3), compiled with USE_DOUBLE_PRECISION and closely following bullet3's own naming and conventions.
